ash_hound.description: Lean ash-coated feral canine; long ribcage, bent hocks, narrow muzzle and individual fur clusters.

ash_hound_alpha.description: Heavier canine with angular ruff, wider shoulder and neck scar; distinct from the smaller pack member.

burrow_rat.description: Low long-bodied rodent with folded ears, projecting snout, claw clusters and articulated bare tail.

murk_leech.description: Eyeless segmented marsh annelid with end sucker and longitudinal contraction.

tender_drone.description: Six articulated tool legs, overlapping iron plates, screw heads, cooling slots and two-jaw service tool.

tender_drone_inert.description: Same original service machine, folded legs and dark inactive aperture.

amalgam.description: Living failed-treatment fusion: three distinct weary human faces, four long arms, joined torsos and dragging worn linen; no skeletal undead anatomy.
